dimensions.names: provide dimension names as JSON array, min 0 max any

measures: provide measure names separated by comma, min 0 max any

color.description: Solid hex string or palette array of hex colors

instructions: This is a flexible/custom chart template for visualization types not covered by predefined templates.
Build a complete DrawOther() chart function for the requested visualization (user question / viz_hint).
IMPORTANT: Do not return ChartSettings — write full JavaScript/JSX. Settings injection does not work for other.
Rules:
1) Do not add imports, wrappers, markdown, or explanation.
2) Keep `data` as-is; never inline sample data or redefine `data`.
3) Return valid JavaScript/JSX with proper braces and closing tags.
4) Function name must remain DrawOther.
How to get and use components:
Note: ChartComponent is for reference you need to replace ChartComponent with one or any from the below
5) Destructure ONLY the required chart/UI components from `components`.
Example: const {{ Line, Bar, Pie, Area, Scatter, Radar, Waterfall, Heatmap, Treemap, WordCloud, RingProgress, Gauge, Column, Table, KPI, Statistic }} = components;
Pick the component that best matches the user question (e.g. Line for trends, Bar/Column for comparisons, Pie for parts-of-whole).
How to map data fields from metadata:
6) Read column names and types from dataset metadata:
- text/categorical/date columns -> dimensions (xField, colorField, wordField, seriesField)
- numeric columns -> measures (yField, angleField, sizeField, weightField, value)
7) Replace placeholder / setting.* field names with actual keys from metadata.
8) Use the first dimension as xField (or colorField for pie charts).
9) Use the first measure as yField (or angleField for pie/doughnut charts).
How to plot labels and axes:
10) Set axis titles using real field names:
xAxis: {{ title: {{ text: dimensionField }} }}
yAxis: {{ title: {{ text: measureField }} }}
11) Add data labels when appropriate:
label: {{ position: "middle", content: (item) => item[measureField] }}
For pie charts: label: {{ type: "outer", content: "{{name}}: {{percentage}}" }}
How to wire helpers and render:
12) Destructure from `helperFunctions`: getTooltip, enableInteractivity, getPropertiesConfig.

13) Return the chart wrapped in
: return
;
